messages:
Morgan (CEO): thanks for coming to the Q&A. opening this thread to capture quick follow-ups on why we won/lost recently and clear next steps. keep replies short so we can triage.
Priya (CS): From CS calls: main blockers = data residency proofs, long legal review cycles, and surprise invoices during marketing spikes. customers keep asking for a downloadable compliance pack.
Kemi (Sales): Field color: lost AdOptima (lost) due to no on-prem option; MedLedger (won) cited our Dedicated offering + a hands-on POC; EduLoop (push) wants a native connector to their LMS. wins consistently mention a dedicated engineer during POC.
Alex (Product): Proposed deliverables: 1) Compliance download pack (certs, timelines, sample clauses). 2) AE collection checklist. 3) 3 quickstart connectors (LMS, legacy CRM, SFTP). Owner: Alex for 1 & 2, Platform for connectors. ETA: 10 business days for pack, 3 sprints for connectors.
Jonas (Eng): Quick engineering wins we can ship: enable prefix KV caching for POCs by default, tune default batching window to 30ms for low-latency profiles, and publish a small "latency checklist". I can draft config snippets.
Aisha (Security): I will assemble a "compliance snippets" folder: network diagram, KMS pattern, retention policy examples. sample S3 policy snippet we can share:
```
{
  "Version": "2012-10-17",
  "Statement": [{"Effect": "Allow","Action": ["s3:GetObject"],"Resource": ["arn:aws:s3:::customer-bucket/*"]}]
}
```
Hazel (Analytics): We need measurables. I'll add win/loss schema and a tiny dashboard: fields = deal_id, stage, reason_tag, mrr, time_to_poc. will measure pre/post artifact release.
Priya (CS): Action: I'll compile anonymized loss notes into a single doc and highlight 5 canonical loss reasons. Owner: Priya + Kemi. ETA: 7 days.
Kemi (Sales): I'll upload sanitized notes to #sales-docs and tag the top 4 accounts for immediate outreach.
Alex (Product): Action: draft AE checklist + compliance one-pager. Owner: Alex. ETA 7 days.
Jonas (Eng): I'll put a small git repo with the latency configs and a short benchmark script. sample CLI to run a quick estimator:
```
./estimate-billing --qps 50 --avg_tokens 120 --model r-instruct-1
```
Output will show estimated tokens / hour and cost.
ci-bot: Created issue #CI-4007: "all-hands: close-the-loop - compliance pack + AE checklist + latency playbook" (https://github.com/redwood-inference/internal/issues/4007)
Morgan (CEO): prioritize compliance pack first. if legal says no, connectors matter less. link owners to the gi hub issue and add due dates.
Priya (CS): scheduling a 30-min review next Mon 11am PT to go over first drafts. invite to @here.
Alex (Product): will post first-pass docs to the issue before the sync.
Hazel (Analytics): will wire up the win/loss dashboard and post a link.
Kemi (Sales): thanks all  I'll start customer outreach once artifacts land.
Morgan (CEO): nice and actionable. small ask: if anyone can produce <2h snippets (network diagram, small Terraform, one-pager) please drop them in the issue now so AEs can use asap. :rocket
